text:
alex.k: Quick heads-up — the onboarding sample app surfaced a bad UX: when our hosted API returns a 401 the sample just shows \"Auth failed\" and the web UI logs a 500. Users get no remediation steps. Can we make SDK errors more explainable (typed exceptions + clear message + remediation)?

maria.p: Ugh yes. Saw a support ticket. We should differentiate expired token vs bad creds vs missing scope.

jean-m: Agreed. Current SDK returns a generic HttpError with status 401/403/429. Hard for app authors to decide retry vs reauth.

sam: Proposal: add a small, consistent error surface across languages: typed exceptions (AuthExpired, AuthInvalid, PermissionDenied, RateLimited, ServiceError) + an \"action\" string and optional \"retry_after\" field in error payload.

alex.k: Example mapping I sketched for the runtime (pseudo):
```
# pseudo-mapping
if status == 401 and body.error == 'token_expired':
    raise AuthExpired(\"token expired, refresh required\", action=\"reauth\")
elif status == 401:
    raise AuthInvalid(\"invalid credentials\", action=\"check_credentials\")
elif status == 403:
    raise PermissionDenied(\"missing scope\", action=\"request_scope:inference:read\")
elif status == 429:
    raise RateLimited(\"rate limit hit\", action=\"backoff\", retry_after=resp.headers.get('Retry-After'))
elif status >= 500:
    raise ServiceError(\"upstream error\", action=\"retry_later\")
```

maria.p: Love it. Important: messages should be short + copy that can be shown to end users (no stack traces). Also SDKs should expose both the typed exception class and a machine-friendly code (e.g. error_code=\"auth.token_expired\").

jean-m: For parity: we need the same shape in JS, Go, Python. Implementation note: Go doesn't do exceptions, so return typed error values with methods: IsRetryable() and Action().

sam: Also recommend adding a small sampleapp change to onboarding: detect AuthExpired and show a CTA \"Reconnect account\" with a one-line reason. That'll cut support friction.

alex.k: TL;DR asks
- Add typed error surface + stable error_code strings
- Add short user-facing message and an action enum
- SDK parity plan: JS/Py/Go mapping docs + example code snippets
- Update onboarding sampleapp to surface actions

maria.p: +1. Also add a small test harness in the repo that mocks 401/403/429 and asserts SDK surfaces.

eng-bot: autobot summary: Proposed new error types: AuthExpired, AuthInvalid, PermissionDenied, RateLimited, ServiceError. Add fields: error_code, user_message, action, retry_after. Create SDK parity ticket and add sampleapp update.

sam: I'll make a tiny RFC PR with the mapping table and sample snippets. Will ping here when ready.

alex.k: Thanks — if anyone has objections to the specific names or codes ping me. Otherwise we'll aim for a lightweight PR this week. :thumbsup:

maria.p: Quick nit — for 5xx we should include a transient boolean and prefer retryable=false by default; ops can override via config.

jean-m: Noted. I'll add Go pattern examples to the RFC.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdks/pull/1234 (draft). includes mapping table + sampleapp patch.

alex.k: Awesome, will review.
